Title: [LSJ] Descent into Darkness and Baltimore's Purge

Messages.Author: Mathieu Dewavrin
Messages.Body:
Hello

Just trying to have fun with some new cards from Gehenna.

What happens during my next untap phase if I play Baltimore's Purge,
then freak drive (or Zilliah's Tears), then Descent into Darkness with
the same vampire.

Will Baltimore's Purge still trigger at the untap phase following the
return to play of this vampire ?

Relevant Texts :

Descent into Darkenss
1 Blood
+1 stealth action. [obt] Turn the acting vampire and any cards on him
or her face down, out of play (breaking any temporary control effects).
Put this card on him or her (in play). During your influence phase,
move 2 blood to this face-down vampire from the blood bank, and you can
choose to burn this card to return the vampire to play, tapped. [OBT]
As above, but the vampire is untapped when he or she returns to play.

Baltimore's Purge
Requires a ready vampire. If this vampire is Ravnos, this action is at
+1 stealth. Put this card on the acting vampire. During your untap
phase, burn this card, and each other Methuselah chooses a ready vampire
he or she controls who is not older than this vampire. If you control a
ready Lasombra, you choose the vampires instead. This vampire and the
chosen vampires go to torpor.

Mathieu Dewavrin
Prince of Nantes

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:
Mathieu Dewavrin wrote:

> Hello
>
> Just trying to have fun with some new cards from Gehenna.
>
> What happens during my next untap phase if I play Baltimore's Purge,
> then freak drive (or Zilliah's Tears), then Descent into Darkness with
> the same vampire.
>
> Will Baltimore's Purge still trigger at the untap phase following the
> return to play of this vampire ?

Yes. While the vampire is in darkness, the BP is out of play, so
doesn't trigger. When the vampire returns, the BP will go off in your
next untap phase.

--Colin McGuigan

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Mathieu Dewavrin <mathieu.dewa...@ifrance.com> wrote:
> What happens during my next untap phase if I play Baltimore's Purge,
> then freak drive (or Zilliah's Tears), then Descent into Darkness with
> the same vampire.

An out-of-play purge does nothing. When you have an untap phase come
around *and* the purge is in play, then it "activates".

Messages.Author: John Flournoy
Messages.Body:
Mathieu Dewavrin <mathieu.dewa...@ifrance.com> wrote in message news:<40aa137d$0$22129$636a...@news.free.fr>...

> Hello
>
> Just trying to have fun with some new cards from Gehenna.
>
> What happens during my next untap phase if I play Baltimore's Purge,
> then freak drive (or Zilliah's Tears), then Descent into Darkness with
> the same vampire.

Since Baltimore Purge will have been 'put on the acting vampire' per
its card text, it will be turned face-down by Descent into Darkness
and be out of play - and thus unable to trigger while that condition
exists.

When the vampire comes back face-up, so does the Purge.

> Will Baltimore's Purge still trigger at the untap phase following the
> return to play of this vampire ?

Yes, because during your untap phase the Purge will be in play, and
its text says that it takes effect then - the Purge says nothing about
your _next_ untap phase; it activates whenever it is your untap phase
and the Purge is actively in play.

So yeah, this'd be a way to delay a Purge for future turns, although
there would still be a cycle of other people's turns between your
flipping it back up (your influence phase) and the next untap phase
you get.
